description: This PHP class 'GlobalConfigSubscriber' is an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM project that sets configuration values based on request parameters during HTTP request handling.

classes.name: GlobalConfigSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens to HTTP request events to set internationalization and date formatting configurations based on query parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the events this subscriber listens to, specifically the KernelRequest event with the onRequestEvent handler.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, extracting query parameters to set configuration flags.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a configuration key-value pair and logs any exception that occurs.
